name: Mayank Hete
tagline: AI governance, data protection technology, and AI security.
bio_short: Computer Science student at SIT Pune (CGPA: 8.00/10) focused on AI governance, privacy engineering, and security. 5× peer-reviewed researcher; builder of open-source AI compliance tools.
bio_long:
I'm a Computer Science and Engineering student at Symbiosis Institute of Technology, Pune, working where data-protection law meets AI engineering. My focus is turning requirements from the EU AI Act, GDPR, India's DPDP Act, and Japan's APPI into concrete, testable controls.

I am co-authoring interdisciplinary research with Symbiosis Law School on detecting conflicts between the GDPR and India's DPDP framework. The work combines language-model analysis with formal constraints so that every reported conflict comes with a derivation that legal experts can review.

I build open-source tools to test AI systems for privacy and compliance risks, alongside production work in LLM engineering and enterprise agent systems. My research also spans post-quantum security and financial analytics, with peer-reviewed work accepted at IEEE and Springer venues.

In October 2026, I supported Japanese working professionals as a Student Buddy for the 20-day NewDaySys AI and cybersecurity training program at Symbiosis Centre for International Education. I am planning to pursue a master's programme in Europe in 2027.
